items.title: Submit Widerspruch against rejection of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch muss uns innerhalb eines Monats erreichen, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der IKK Mustertal, Handwerkerplatz 3, 57072 Mustertal.
items.computation: Letter dated Tuesday 20.04.2027, sent by regular post by a public-law body (Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts), so § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 3rd day after posting = 23.04.2027 (Friday, a working day, so no further shift needed for the delivery fiction itself). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist is an event-triggered period (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): the day of bekanntgegeben (23.04.) is not counted, the period starts 24.04.2027. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 23.05.2027. That date, 23.05.2027, is a Sunday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next working day. 24.05.2027 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NRW (Pfingstmontag that year falls on 07.06.2027), so it is a valid working day.
